consumer: The GUI monster-status/sidebar widget that renders each visible monster's HP bar and SHOWS it by mapping the hp/hp_max ratio onto the GUI's green/yellow/red color band and bar glyphs.
scope: Only what the GUI would display per visible monster: the formatted colored bar for monsters the player can currently see (the seen/LOS-filtered display view), not raw state and not an engine predicate.
decisive_source: The actual GUI HP-bar formatter (get_hp_bar / color-band chooser) is NOT shown in any excerpt; Excerpt 1 src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities only emits raw mon.get_hp()/get_hp_max() integers (class S), and Excerpt 3 creature.cpp::Creature::sees only gates visibility, neither computes the displayed color band.
divergence: A monster present in world state with positive get_hp() but currently outside the player's LOS (Creature::sees()==false): raw-state HP would report a bar, yet the GUI displays no HP bar at all, exposing a raw-state answer as the wrong authority for what is SHOWN.
